Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic phosphoproteomics workflow using Ti4-IMAC enrichment and DDA-based label-free quantification. Site-level output is required as the study focuses on specific phosphosites and kinase-substrate motifs.

scope: We interrogated the phosphoproteome by enriching the phospho-fraction out of 250 micrograms of purified protein per sample by Ti4-IMAC chromatography coupled with mass-spectrometry.
Frozen tumor samples were homogenized using a Precellys 24 device (Bertin Technologies) in ice-cold lysis buffer
Tumor cell lines were washed 2 times with cold PBS 1× and harvested in ice-cold lysis buffer
Protein lysates from tumors and cells were sonicated for 15 min on ice and clarified by centrifugation at 14,100 × g at 4 °C for 15 min.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by MS was a phosphopeptide-enriched fraction derived from whole tumor and cell line lysates. Per the priority rules, since the starting material for the phosphoproteomics was the total protein extract (lysate) and not an affinity-purified protein complex or a specific organelle, it is classified as whole cell lysate.
